description: This file contains utility functions and mixins for Bootstrap, including validation of map ordering, color manipulation, contrast calculations, string manipulations, SVG escaping, and responsive design helpers. It is used to extend and facilitate styling and theme customization within a Bootstrap-based project.
external_files: None explicitly referenced in the code

methods.name: _assert-ascending
methods.description: Ensures the values in a Sass map are in ascending order, warns if not.

methods.name: _assert-starts-at-zero
methods.description: Checks that the first value of a breakpoints map starts at zero; warns if not.

methods.name: to-rgb
methods.description: Converts a color value to its RGB components.

methods.name: rgba-css-var
methods.description: Generates an RGBA CSS variable string based on identifier and target, with handling for specific body background and text.

methods.name: map-loop
methods.description: Iterates over a Sass map, applying a function to each key-value pair.

methods.name: varify
methods.description: Generates a list of CSS variable references based on a list of entries.

methods.name: negativify-map
methods.description: Transforms a Sass map into its negative variant with 'n' prefixes and negative values.

methods.name: map-get-multiple
methods.description: Retrieves multiple key-value pairs from a map based on a list of keys.

methods.name: map-merge-multiple
methods.description: Merges multiple Sass maps into one.

methods.name: str-replace
methods.description: Replaces all occurrences of a substring within a string, used for SVG background manipulation.

methods.name: escape-svg
methods.description: Escapes special characters in SVG strings for use in CSS.

methods.name: color-contrast
methods.description: Determines a contrasting color against a background based on WCAG contrast ratio requirements.

methods.name: contrast-ratio
methods.description: Calculates contrast ratio between background and foreground colors.

methods.name: luminance
methods.description: Calculates the WCAG relative luminance of a color.

methods.name: opaque
methods.description: Calculates an opaque color from a foreground over a background.

methods.name: tint-color
methods.description: Lightens a color by mixing it with white.

methods.name: shade-color
methods.description: Darkens a color by mixing it with black.

methods.name: shift-color
methods.description: Shades or tints a color based on the weight.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds two values, returning a calc expression if necessary.

methods.name: subtract
methods.description: Subtracts two values, returning a calc expression if necessary.

methods.name: divide
methods.description: Divides two numbers with optional precision, considering units.
